item.title: Roncalli adds two to football coaching staff for next football season
item.description: Aberdeen Roncalli has announced the addition to its football coaching staff. According to the Roncalli football team’s X account Jeff Larson will join the team bringing 23 years of coaching experience, 18 at the college level including as a defensive coordinator.
